blurb: Jupiter Sunset Cruises is operated by Captain Jeff Haley of TenX Charters. Captain Jeff is a United States Coast Guard Licensed Master and prides himself on providing his guests with the safest charter experience. Our 31 Regulator is outfitted with all the highest level safety equipment and is the perfect vessel for parties up to 6 guests to enjoy cruises along the beautiful intracoastal waters of Jupiter,
